summary: Liberty Global Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting completion on July 31, 2026, of its subsidiary Ziggo Group's acquisition from Vodafone Sellers of the remaining 50% of VodafoneZiggo Group Holding B.V. and all related shareholder loans. The transaction closed under a February 18, 2026 Sale and Purchase Agreement. Post-closing, Ziggo Group owns Telenet and VodafoneZiggo, with a 50%-minus-one economic interest in Telenet's Wyre Holding stake. Liberty Global plans to spin off and list Ziggo Group on Euronext Amsterdam. No price per share, premium, or advisors disclosed. Watch for spin-off details and regulatory approvals.
